title: Kitab al-Tawhid
author: al-maturidi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Maturidi's systematic defence of the unity of God and the createdness of the world, arguing from reason and revelation against the dualists, the philosophers, the Mu'tazila and the anthropomorphists. It treats God's attributes, the status of the believer, the nature of faith, free will and the sources of religious knowledge.
historicalContext: Written in Samarkand in the early tenth century, the work founded the Maturidi school of Sunni theology, which with Ash'arism became one of the two dominant schools of kalam. Its rational method and its insistence on the compatibility of reason with revelation shaped later Hanafi theology.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
